notes: - **A cohort is now a first-class entity, and membership is many-to-many.** A security belongs to its sector, its size band, an index, any factor screen it satisfies and any custom list containing it — *simultaneously* — and valuation reads differently against each. So the analytical answer is a **set of readings, not a scalar**, and `cohorts_for_symbol` is the central query. - **Why the shape was forced.** A 56-name, 7-sector study measured median price ÷ substantiated value at **1.07× (Financials) to 3.58× (Energy)**, with **33.6% of premium variance between sectors** — so a single universe
